title: Give planner artifacts stable URN-based names matching the registered grammar

facts.note: Sole applicability gate: being a planner artifact is sufficient. Applies to every planner artifact (new or existing, compliant or not), independent of any operation event, author or phase. Requires an observer that classifies a file or record as a planner artifact; no such classifier exists yet. Violation findings (non-URN name, grammar mismatch, changed URN) are verifier outputs, not activation prerequisites — see verifier_detail.

fires: A new planner artifact is created with a correctly formed URN-based name (rule applies; it is satisfied).
A new planner artifact is created with a free-form name.
An existing planner artifact is renamed, moved or refactored and its URN stays unchanged (rule applies; it is satisfied).
An existing planner artifact is renamed or refactored and its URN changes.
An existing planner artifact is evaluated (e.g. a repository-wide review) without any current edit, and its name is checked against the registered grammar.
doesNotFire: Files or records that are not planner artifacts (e.g. application source code).

given: A planner artifact (for example a plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance or planning doc; the list is not exhaustive)
when: you author, name, review or change it — or it simply exists in the repository
then: The artifact carries a stable URN-based name that matches the registered grammar and stays constant across renames/refactors.
prefer: Look up the repository's registered naming grammar before naming, build the name as a URN from it (a stable_name), and check the name parses against that grammar.
Keep the same URN when the artifact is renamed, moved or refactored.
avoid: Free-form or ad-hoc names that do not match the registered grammar.
Changing an artifact's URN as part of a rename or refactor.
why: The convention defines a stable_name as URN-based, constant across renames/refactors and conforming to the registered grammar; planner artifacts must carry such a name.
evidence: Each planner artifact's name is URN-based and parses against the registered naming grammar.
Planner artifact URNs are unchanged across rename/refactor diffs.
verifier_detail: Term stable_name: a URN-based artifact name that stays constant across renames/refactors and matches the registered grammar.

Possible findings for an in-scope planner artifact: artifact_name_not_urn_based, artifact_name_not_matching_registered_grammar, artifact_urn_changed (requires the prior URN for comparison). Absence of findings means the rule is satisfied, not that it does not apply.
